resources.label: Tribal Community Resilience program
resources.description: Technical and financial assistance for federally recognized Tribes and Alaska Native Villages on natural hazard preparedness, including community-driven relocation, managed retreat, and protect-in-place, to protect Tribal Trust and Treaty assets and human health and safety.

resources.label: Tribal Community Resilience Annual Awards Program
resources.description: Competitive funding for federally recognized Tribes and Tribal organizations to build community resilience capacity; the program page says updates on future funding cycles are pending.

resources.label: Sanitation Facilities Construction program
resources.description: The nationwide program for safe drinking-water, wastewater, and solid-waste facilities in American Indian and Alaska Native communities.

resources.label: Native American Affairs Technical Assistance Program
resources.description: Technical assistance for Tribes to develop, manage, and protect their water and related resources, including Tribal drought-resiliency assistance.

resources.label: Office of Tribal Relations
resources.description: The USDA staff office in the Office of the Secretary responsible for government-to-government relations between USDA and Tribal governments, and a single point of contact for Tribal issues.

resources.label: USDA partnerships with Tribal Nations
resources.description: A hub for Tribal Nations and Tribal producers to access farm and conservation programs across Tribal lands.

resources.label: DisasterAssistance.gov
resources.description: The federal portal to find and apply for disaster assistance after a declared disaster.

resources.label: Hazard Mitigation Assistance grants
resources.description: The mitigation grant family (the Hazard Mitigation Grant Program, Flood Mitigation Assistance, and related programs); several activate only after a presidential disaster declaration.

resources.label: Disaster assistance loans
resources.description: Disaster loan programs for businesses, private nonprofit organizations, homeowners, and renters in declared disaster areas.

resources.label: Livestock Forage Disaster Program
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Farm Service Agency (FSA)
resources.description: The standing program for grazing losses in counties the U.S. Drought Monitor rates at severe drought (D2) or worse.

resources.label: Farm Service Agency disaster assistance programs
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Farm Service Agency (FSA)
resources.description: The hub for agricultural disaster programs, including livestock, honeybee, farm-raised fish, tree, and emergency conservation assistance.

resources.label: Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery
resources.agency: United States Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
resources.description: Recovery funds allocated to States, Tribes, cities, and counties after a presidentially declared disaster and a congressional appropriation.

resources.label: WaterSMART program
resources.description: The umbrella for the bureau's water-sustainability funding programs (efficiency, conservation, watershed, and recycling projects) across the Western states.

resources.label: Drought Response Program
resources.description: Funding programs for drought contingency planning and drought resiliency projects.

resources.label: Environmental Quality Incentives Program
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS)
resources.description: Financial and technical assistance for conservation practices, including water conservation and drought resilience; applications route through local NRCS offices.

resources.label: Emergency Watershed Protection Program
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS)
resources.description: Assistance to relieve imminent watershed threats after a natural disaster, through a local sponsor; no federal disaster declaration is required.

resources.label: Water and Environmental Programs
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Rural Development
resources.description: Loan and grant programs for rural drinking-water and waste infrastructure, including Tribal-eligible sub-programs.

resources.label: Drought preparedness and response information
resources.description: Preparation and response information for households, utilities, and communities, with links to water-system resilience resources.

resources.label: Community Wildfire Defense Grant Program
resources.agency: United States Department of Agriculture, Forest Service
resources.description: Competitive grants for communities and Tribes to plan for and reduce wildfire risk.

resources.label: Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program
resources.agency: United States Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
resources.description: Home energy assistance, including summer cooling; administered through State, Tribal, and Territorial grantees.

resources.label: Grants.gov
resources.agency: All federal grant-making agencies (administered by the United States Department of Health and Human Services)
resources.description: The central federal site to search grant opportunities across every agency.
